verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall helper for native binary validation and optional wasm fallback.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to identify target package name
behaviors.analysis: Uses INIT_CWD and path.resolve to locate package.json, a standard npm pattern for postinstall scripts.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate identification of installed package context.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install command to download @swc/wasm as fallback
behaviors.analysis: Calls child_process.execSync with npm install command, using system npm to fetch optional dependency.
behaviors.impact: Standard behavior for ensuring native binary availability when not present.

behaviors.behavior: Removes temporary installation directory after operation
behaviors.analysis: Uses fs.readdirSync, lstatSync, unlinkSync, and rmdirSync to clean up temporary directory.
behaviors.impact: Cleanup of transient files created during postinstall process.

decision.label: benign
reasons: Install path not fully reviewed; human review required
